capabilityIntro: Fire sprinkler drafting and BIM production support for contractors and trade coordination teams. We start with reviewed inputs and return editable updates, check plots and questions for the authorized project team.

capabilities.title: Approved redlines and record updates
capabilities.summary: Carry designer-approved revisions into the supplied drawing or model and show how each input was handled.
inputs: Accepted base file, markup package and revision list
Layer or family standards and sheet templates
Authorized client reviewer and expected issue format
outputs: Editable draft in the agreed tool and a check PDF
Revision register tied to source comments
Held questions with owners and affected sheets
checks: Compare each changed item to its approval
Check tags, references and plotted revisions across the set
Keep conflicting instructions open for the lead designer

capabilities.title: BIM coordination support
capabilities.summary: Use the provided trade exports to document overlaps and implement the client’s approved responses.
inputs: Accepted model revisions, shared coordinates and issue conventions
Trade views and criteria supplied by the coordination lead
Approved dispositions and source evidence for any changes
outputs: Named views or model revision in the agreed workflow
Source and change references for each affected item
checks: Confirm linked model revisions and coordinate alignment
Separate observed overlap from confirmed clash disposition
Keep changes tied to the responsible designer and trade lead

capabilities.title: Shop drawing and schedule extraction
capabilities.summary: Produce a review extract from an approved source model, with the contractor’s shop lead controlling fabrication release.
inputs: Sheet and schedule standards, extraction limits and hold rules
Contractor shop reviewer and output versions
outputs: Draft shop sheets and schedules from the approved source
Working files and plots for the fabrication lead
checks: Trace IDs and values to the approved source revision
Keep held items out of the extracted schedule
Have the contractor confirm fabrication dimensions, counts and release

capabilities.title: Issue registers and drawing QA
capabilities.summary: Maintain a reviewable record of sheet, model and issue changes across handoffs.
inputs: Current file index, title block and revision conventions
Authorized change list and expected deliverables
checks: Open the agreed file version and reconcile reference paths
Compare plotted tags and issue status to the underlying record
Route missing design information to the authorized reviewer

formats: Editable files in an agreed and verified AutoCAD, Revit or contractor-specific workflow
Check PDFs, issue register and a source revision list
Review sheets and schedules when extraction scope is authorized
Editable DXF and PDF for the synthetic examples
requirements: Accepted drawing or model revision, markups and references
Project CAD standards, software version and permissions to share the inputs
Named client reviewer and applicable project and jurisdiction requirements
boundaries: The authorized professional or contractor selects and approves system design, equipment and layout criteria.
The responsible project team owns hydraulics, compliance decisions and field verification.
The client’s authorized team controls permit, fabrication and installation release.
